retained_families.family: Residential, master-meter, tenant, assistance and special residential programs
retained_families.connection: Actual source records expressly concern domestic, multifamily, mobilehome and other residential accommodation, tenants, or housing-facility assistance. They determine service continuity, bills, deposits, certifications and master-meter allocations. Agricultural-worker housing is housing, not farming.

retained_families.family: General service, pumping, outdoor/parking/walkway lighting, HVAC, EV charging and customer equipment financing
retained_families.connection: Shared residential premises have physical plant and common areas with their own utility service. These source families expressly concern those service and equipment functions. SCE Form14-685 expressly connects parking-lot lighting to LS-1. Customer installation, financing, access, inspection, repair and account termination are operating decisions. Retaining a mixed tariff does not select every commercial industry it serves.

retained_families.family: Customer self-generation, net billing/metering, multifamily allocations, standby, interconnection
retained_families.connection: Property self-generation changes installation, interconnection, customer-of-record transitions, bill credits and account closeout. Explicit multifamily MASH, SOMAH, NEM-V and NBT-V sources establish this connection. Own-use generation and standby supply are distinct from operating an independent power-supply business.

retained_families.family: Customer-side supply choice, direct access, CCA, transported gas, curtailment, imbalance service
retained_families.connection: A customer account may change supply, terminate enrollment, owe charges or settle credits. The saved G-IMB text expressly includes end-use customers and charges or trades offsetting their delivery-versus-use imbalance. This establishes a customer settlement connection. It does not import independent aggregator, marketer, storage or backbone-service business contracts.

RES-BCT benefiting-account designations and government/institutional on-bill financing concern customer property energy or financing. In contrast, the saved WATER tariff addresses public water-agency generation, and saved Wi-Fi/ROW contracts address community networks or telecommunications providers. Public ownership alone does not connect those separate functions.

retained_families.decision: retain customer permissions, equipment and account terms
retained_families.connection: A building customer controls metered load and equipment operation and receives related rebates or account adjustments. The census expressly includes customer agreements, opt-outs and authorizations. Independent aggregator agreements remain excluded.

retained_families.family: Experimental V2G, BTMM, generic CHP/CREST, station-power mixed sources
retained_families.decision: no blanket exclusion in this delta
retained_families.connection: An experimental or unidentified title does not establish that a source is outside. The saved evidence does not show that every customer-premises equipment or account branch is excluded. This delta does not recommend blanket removal of BTMM, V2G, CHP/CREST or station-power mixed sources, or claim newly established eligibility.

retained_families.decision: keep existing clear internal-account exclusions; do not newly exclude mixed selected EE/FF/HH on label alone
retained_families.connection: Internal utility revenue and cost accounting has no operator consumer. Customer refunds or adjustments can have one. Existing saved titles alone do not support removing every selected EE/FF/HH mixed mechanism. No additional automatic exclusions are proposed for those units.

socalgas: No additional entire mixed customer-unit exclusions are justified by the saved actual excerpts beyond the already recorded wholesale, storage, production, internal-account and DRRP exclusions. Keep conditional end-use account branches without importing all referenced provider businesses.

rainwater_instrument.name: H2OC RainSmart participant work and rebate conditions in Agreement MA-080-26011156
rainwater_instrument.applicability: Participating residential properties receiving water from El Toro Water District, Laguna Beach County Water District, Moulton Niguel Water District, Santa Margarita Water District, South Coast Water District, Trabuco Canyon Water District, or the City of San Clemente. Huntington Beach is not included. Section2.5 permits territorial expansion only with both parties’ approval. The Orange County parent layer includes conditional programs outside Huntington Beach.

units_in_scope.unit: Participant conditions, notices to proceed, work completion and rebate payment

section_list.heading: H2OC RainSmart owner work/rebate provisions and Exhibits1–3

selected_provisions: Recitals: participant territory and residential/commercial scope
Sections1.2–1.3: termination effect on approved participant rebates only
Sections2.2.2–2.2.6: notice to proceed, cancellation/extension, completion verification, available-funds limit and W9
Section2.3: participant rebate processing and payment only
Section3: project scenarios and incorporation of workflow
Section5.4: disclaimer concerning participant-selected work and products
units_in_scope.reason: Concrete residential landscape work: remove turf, install a rain garden, cistern or rain barrel, obtain project approval, verify completion and receipts, and receive a rebate. The agreement expressly incorporates owner-facing participant conditions. These provisions are more than county procurement administration.

units_out.reason: County/MWDOC funding transfers, agency fees, reporting, agency record retention, mutual indemnity, and interagency dispute, notice, amendment or execution mechanics do not direct operator work or account decisions. Keep the complete carrier PDF without compiling these as owner obligations.

rainwater_instrument.source_limit: Exhibits1–2 include image pages. Their actual pages require OCR/rendering during J2. J1 source identity, relevant units and the operating connection are established without full transcription.
rainwater_instrument.version_note: Board-approved attachment; unfilled execution signatures are not represented as an executed contract. Program adoption and participant conditions are selected from the approved item.
